style: Read this line of a short product video in English, in a warm, upbeat and confident voice, at a lively, brisk pace, without adding any words:

lines.text: Meet SimplyBar, a free system monitor for your Mac's menu bar.
Open the settings and switch on the modules you want.
Click any item to see the details.
To add widgets, right-click the desktop and choose Edit Widgets.
Drag them in: CPU, memory, network, SSD and storage.
SimplyBar. Free and open source, on the Mac App Store.
